Akhilesh Yadav Alleges Voter List Manipulation Ahead of UP Polls

Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav has accused the ruling BJP of preparing to manipulate the voter list ahead of the Uttar Pradesh Assembly polls. Yadav claimed that the BJP is attempting to remove voters from the list and urged voters to remain vigilant. He also stated that the BJP's "loot" and "great robbery" would be returned to the poor. One report also discussed the potential impact of Yadav's remarks on Jayant Chaudhary and the SP's electoral prospects in western Uttar Pradesh.
